Changes follow under Major, Minor and Patch headings by each change's highest bump. A change shared by several packages appears once and lists them. A changeset's first paragraph is its title, cut at 120 characters with the whole text kept as its detail. A summary that opens with a heading, list, quote, table, fence, image or HTML has no title, and the changeset name stands in. A \"Read before merging\" callout lists each `Breaking:` and `Action:` marker in a changeset summary with the packages it affects, and the publishable packages whose source (not tests, benches, examples, snapshots or Markdown) changed since their last tag but that no bump or group includes; a breaking marker removes the compatibility claim from the opening callout, a change whose changeset was added by a merged pull request (read from the merge commits with one `git log`, from the merge subject `Merge pull request #N` or a trailing `(#N)`) names it as `#N`, and a `Breaking:` marker on a change whose own bump is below what a breaking change needs (major from 1.0.0, minor before) is listed as \"Check the bump\" with the packages and the bump it has.
